recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有數個芽細胞，細胞質嗜鹼性且邊緣呈不規則泡狀或尖狀突起（blebs/pseudopods），核仁可見，另有一個有核紅血球；帶突起的芽細胞是巨核芽細胞線索，在唐氏症新生兒提示暫時性異常骨髓增生（TAM）。
features: Blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio, round nuclei, fine chromatin and one or more visible nucleoli
Basophilic cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic blebs, budding and pointed pseudopod-like projections
Some blasts with fine cytoplasmic granularity and irregular cell outline
A small nucleated red cell with pyknotic nucleus
Red cells with slit-like stomatocytic pallor and occasional teardrop/fragment forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa, oil immersion) shows several circulating blasts with fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm exhibiting irregular blebs and pseudopod-like projections, compatible with megakaryoblasts. A nucleated red cell is present, and red cells show stomatocyte-like forms with occasional teardrop and fragmented cells. Auer rods are not seen. In a neonate with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; flow cytometry (CD41, CD61, CD42b, CD34, CD117) and GATA1 mutation studies confirm the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: ML-DS has similar megakaryoblasts but presents later in infancy with persistent disease and often a preceding myelodysplastic phase.
Monoblasts have abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase and CD14/CD64 positive rather than CD41/CD61.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express TdT with B- or T-lineage markers.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant blue cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and mature chromatin without nucleoli.
